newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA - April 8.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA - April 8.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers continues at a standstill, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was fair, and most bidding $107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis to occasionally $108.00.

Seller interest light. Many pricing stock around the $109.00 figure. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Sales confirmed - None For the week - 15,000
